# Hi, I'm Krithik

Undergrad developer building practical AI apps with the Claude API. I like shipping small, working demos fast — then teaching others to do the same through workshops and hackathons.

**Focus right now:** Claude API apps (RAG, tool use, streaming) + running 60-minute builder workshops on campus.

## What I do

- **Build with Claude:** chat apps, RAG assistants, tool-using agents with the Anthropic SDK
- **Hackathons:** co-built PatchPilot, an autonomous bug-fix agent (issue in, tested PR out)
- **Teach:** maintain a ready-to-run Claude Builder Workshop kit any club can run in 60 minutes

## Tech stack

## Featured projects

### 1. Claude Builder Workshop
Ready-to-run 60-minute workshop kit: streaming chat starter, personas, token literacy, and a tool-using mini-agent. Facilitator run-of-show + attendee exercises included.

- Stack: Python, Streamlit, Anthropic SDK
- Repo: [krithikmohan30/claude-builder-workshop](https://github.com/krithikmohan30/claude-builder-workshop)

### 2. PatchPilot (AlphaTech)
Autonomous bug-fix agent built for iQOO Hackathon 2026. Takes a GitHub issue, reproduces it, patches code, runs tests, and opens a PR.

- Stack: Python, LLM agents, GitHub API
- Repo: [krithikmohan30/PatchPilot-AlphaTech](https://github.com/krithikmohan30/PatchPilot-AlphaTech)

### 3. Portfolio Site
Full-stack portfolio on Next.js 15 + Supabase (Postgres + Auth), deployed on Vercel free tier. Admin panel to add projects without touching code.

- Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase
- Status: deploy live link here once shipped

## Currently

- [ ] Running Claude intro workshops using the kit above — PRs from real rooms welcome
- [ ] Applying to Claude Campus Ambassador (Builder Club track, 2026-27)
- [ ] Open to hackathons, open source, and internships
